description: This file provides R class definitions and methods for integrating MLlib statistical tests, specifically the Kolmogorov-Smirnov test, with Spark DataFrames. It includes class creation, test execution, and result summarization functions.

classes.name: KSTest
classes.description: S4 class representing a Kolmogorov-Smirnov test result, holding a Java object reference.

methods.name: spark.kstest
methods.description: Performs the two-sided Kolmogorov-Smirnov test on a SparkDataFrame for normal distribution.

methods.name: summary
methods.description: Extracts summary information (p-value, statistic, etc.) from a KSTest object.

methods.name: print.summary.KSTest
methods.description: Prints a human-readable summary of the KSTest result.
